members.summary: This November will mark the sixth anniversary of the PlayStation 5 console's launch, but in the years since its arrival, the gaming market has changed dramatically. The trend of consoles becoming cheaper over time has vanished this generation, as the PS5 now costs more today than it did in 2020, and the expectation is that Sony's hardware sales could slow down over time. Sony doesn't seem too worried about that, as company president and CEO Hiroki Totoki explained that there's no need to "aggressively" sell the console. members.title: Dragon Ball Free-To-Play MOBA Announces Major "Overhaul" Ahead Of First Anniversary
members.summary: "This was not a decision made lightly". The free-to-play MOBA game Dragon Ball Gekishin Squadra celebrates its second anniversary in September, and to mark this occasion, Bandai Namco has provided a development update. The big news is the game will be getting a major update, "or rather overhaul" that makes significant gameplay changes, steering it in a new direction. The reason behind the changes are due to the "high barrier to competitive play" and wanting to make the game more accessible to wider audiences for "years to come". Read the full article on nintendolife.com
